component.name: Acid Cam
component.summary: Create real-time glitch art from cameras and videos

description.p: Acid Cam applies real-time visual distortion filters to webcam feeds, video files, and images. Build custom filter chains, preview the result, and record processed video with FFmpeg.
The libacidcam filter engine provides thousands of effects for glitch art, experimental video, live visuals, and source-material generation.

screenshot.caption: Acid Cam filter and recording interface

description.p: Improves capture stability, FFmpeg encoding, camera timing, and recording controls.
